title: How did electric vehicle registrations change?
description: A clustered bar graph of electric vehicle registrations in some states is read with its scale. The video finds how many more Assam registered, how many times West Bengal grew, and tests a claim about Uttarakhand.
teaching_notes: One idea: a bar shows the count for one year, so a small rise between bars does not mean few registrations. Watch for students who read the change in height as the number of new vehicles.

source: Electric vehicle registrations in some states, 2022 to 2024, scale 1 unit = 25000 vehicles: how many more in Assam, how many times more in West Bengal, and the claim about Uttarakhand
video_script.why: The child can read a bar with its scale and now uses two readings to answer how many more, how many times, and whether a claim holds.
video_script.substitution: Read the bars with the scale, subtract for how many more, and divide for how many times.
video_script.anchor: Registrations (estimates, three bars per state for 2022, 2023, 2024): Assam 40000, 60000, 64500; West Bengal 10500 (2022) and 43000 (2024); Uttarakhand 15000, 16500, 19000. Scale 1 unit = 25000 vehicles.
video_script.payoff_line: Assam registered about twenty thousand more, and West Bengal grew about four times.

final_answer.value: (d) about 20000 more (e) about 4 times (43000 / 10500 = 4.1) (f) not correct: about 16500 and 19000 new registrations; only the increase was small
final_answer.spoken: Assam about twenty thousand more; West Bengal about four times; the claim about Uttarakhand is not correct

maths_rules: Uttarakhand 2023 about 16500, 2024 about 19000: each bar is that year's new registrations, only the increase is small
West Bengal 2022 about 10500, 2024 about 43000: 43000 / 10500 = 4.1, about 4 times
video_script.design: One idea: a bar counts one year, so differences and ratios come from two readings. The state clusters sit in the anchor; on the board two readings are subtracted, one is compared with a bar, and two are divided.
open_questions: The bar readings (Assam 40000 and 60000, West Bengal 10500 and 43000, Uttarakhand 16500 and 19000) are estimates from the worklist; the extracted book text has no readings for this graph. Check against the printed graph.

beats.on_screen: To find: how many more in Assam; is the Uttarakhand claim correct; how many times more in West Bengal
narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>We have to find how many more, test a claim, and find how many times more.

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Step one, Assam. It registered about forty thousand in twenty twenty two and sixty thousand in twenty twenty three.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>To find how many more, subtract. Sixty thousand take away forty thousand is twenty thousand.

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Step two, test the claim about Uttarakhand. Its bars are about sixteen thousand five hundred and nineteen thousand.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Each bar is that year's new registrations, and these are not tiny numbers.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Only the increase from one year to the next is small.

marks.m1: the two West Bengal bars are placed one over the other
marks.m2: 43000 ÷ 10500 is written with a question mark

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Step three, West Bengal. It had about ten thousand five hundred in twenty twenty two. In twenty twenty four it had forty three thousand.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>To find how many times more, divide the later bar by the earlier one.
<bookmark mark='m1'/>Step four, check the division with a multiplication.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Four times ten thousand five hundred is forty two thousand.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>That is close to forty three thousand.

beats.on_screen: Answer: Assam about 20000 more; West Bengal 43000 ÷ 10500 ≈ 4.1, about 4 times; the Uttarakhand claim is not correct

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Assam registered about twenty thousand more, and West Bengal grew about four times.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>The exact division gives four point one, which is close to four.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>The claim about Uttarakhand is not correct, because many vehicles were registered in those years.
